pawn ticket.d: a pawnbroker's receipt for articles taken as security

paw.d: the (prehensile) extremity of the superior limb

pawnbroker.d: a person who lends money at interest in exchange for personal property that is deposited as security

pawnshop.d: a shop where loans are made with personal property as security

pawn.d: a person used by another to gain an end

pawpaw.d: tropical American shrub or small tree having huge deeply palmately cleft leaves and large oblong yellow fruit

pawl.d: a hinged catch that fits into a notch of a ratchet to move a wheel forward or prevent it from moving backward

pawer.d: a person who handles or caresses in a clumsy or overfamiliar manner
